SELECT DISTINCT sb.id,sb.menu_id,sb.button_name, sb.sub_menu, IFNULL(sbp.perm_scope, 'CURRENT_USER') AS perm_scope, bp.id as perm_id, sbp.perm_start_time, sbp.perm_end_time, bp.perm_action, IF(sdp.id is null, '-','已配置') AS data_perm,IF(scp.id is null ,'-','已配置') AS column_perm FROM sys_button sb INNER JOIN sys_role_resource srr ON sb.id = srr.resource_id AND srr.resource_type = 'BUTTON' INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = srr.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_business_perm bp ON bp.button_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN sys_user_business_perm sbp ON sbp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.user_id = sbp.user_id AND sbp.org_id = ur.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_data_perm sdp ON sdp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.user_id = sdp.user_id AND sdp.org_id = ur.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_column_perm scp ON scp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.user_id = scp.user_id AND scp.org_id = ur.org_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND ur.org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND sb.be_unauth = 0

SELECT DISTINCT sb.id, sb.menu_id,sb.button_name, sb.sub_menu, IFNULL(sbp.perm_scope, 'CURRENT_USER') AS perm_scope, bp.id as perm_id, sbp.perm_start_time, sbp.perm_end_time, bp.perm_action, IF(sdp.id is null, '-','已配置') AS data_perm, IF(scp.id is null ,'-','已配置') AS column_perm FROM sys_button sb INNER JOIN sys_role_resource srr ON sb.id = srr.resource_id AND srr.resource_type = 'BUTTON' INNER JOIN sys_uset_role ur ON ur.role_id = srr.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_business_perm bp ON bp.button_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN sys_uset_business_perm sbp ON sbp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.uset_id = sbp.uset_id LEFT JOIN sys_uset_data_perm sdp ON sdp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.uset_id = sdp.uset_id LEFT JOIN sys_uset_column_perm scp ON scp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.uset_id = scp.uset_id WHERE ur.uset_id = #{usetId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND sb.be_unauth = 0 ORDER BY sb.sub_menu DESC

SELECT bp.id as perm_id,IFNULL(sbp.perm_scope, 'CURRENT_USER') AS perm_scope, sbp.perm_start_time, sbp.perm_end_time, bp.perm_action FROM sys_business_perm bp LEFT JOIN sys_user_business_perm sbp ON sbp.perm_id = bp.id
sbp.user_id = #{userId} and sbp.org_id = #{orgId} and bp.id = #{permId}
